Flights Quick Deals Earn 25K American Airlines miles when joining AAdvantage Business (clawbacks happening) By Stephen Pepper  -  July 8, 2026 31 Update 7/10/26:  Unfortunately, we’ve now received numerous reader reports that AA is clawing back the 25,000 bonus miles it awarded under this promo and replacing them with 5,000 miles instead. This may not happen for everyone, but it will likely be most folks’ fate. Sigh. ~~ Update 7/9/26:  Numerous reader reports in the comments say the bonus points are no longer posting, so this deal sadly seems to be dead. ~~ American Airlines is running a generous promotion at the moment, offering 25,000 bonus AAdvantage miles when you join AAdvantage Business and use promo code JOINA7. Unfortunately, most one-person operations won’t be eligible, as the business must have at least five active travelers and spend at least $5,000 in a calendar year to trigger the bonus miles. However, a reader has confirmed that if you have the Citi® / AAdvantage Business™ World Elite Mastercard®, that waives those requirements and you’ll be eligible for the 25K miles. The Deal Earn 25,000 American Airlines miles when you join AAdvantage Business and use promo code JOINA7. Direct link to offer . Key Terms This is an exclusive offer available only to eligible businesses that successfully register in the  AAdvantage  Business program using promo code JOINA7 during the promotion period. This offer ends on July 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM CDT. All enrollments received after this date will not be eligible for the bonus miles offer. Each business is eligible for only one (1) enrollment bonus mile offer. Existing  AAdvantage  Business program members are not eligible for this offer. Enrollment bonus of 25,000  AAdvantage  miles will be deposited to the eligible  AAdvantage  Business account within six (6) to eight (8) weeks following the successful enrollment in the  AAdvantage  Business program. AAdvantage  Business members must meet program activity requirements to access bonus and earned program miles – including the bonus miles associated with this enrollment offer. The minimum requirements are 5 active travelers and $5,000 USD in eligible program travel from the active travelers in a calendar year. See  AAdvantage  Business Terms & Conditions for more details. All miles awarded in connection with this promotion will be bonus miles. Bonus miles do not count toward  AAdvantage  status qualification or  AAdvantage  Million Miler status. Bonus miles are subject to the  AAdvantage  program terms and conditions. This offer may not be combined with any other  AAdvantage  Business promotional enrollment offer. Only one enrollment promotional offer may be applied per eligible enrollment. Quick Thoughts At first glance, this seemed like a ridiculously generous offer, as the email from American Airlines initially made it seem like you’d get 25,000 bonus miles just for registering for the program. Sadly, that’s not the whole story based on the full terms and conditions. That’s because you have to meet the program’s standard requirements to trigger the bonus. That involves having at least five  active  travelers and the business spending at least $5,000 in a calendar year. However, reader Andrew has confirmed that if you have the Citi®/AAdvantage Business™ World Elite Mastercard®, those requirements are waived, and the 25K bonus miles will be awarded instantly. That makes this a no-brainer deal if you have that card. 
Want to learn more about miles and points?  Subscribe to email updates  or check out  our podcast  on your favorite podcast platform.
